overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Council's December 2014 executive sessions on pending federal litigation, including settlement, properly invoked Purpose 3 after the chair's declaration.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges the Council improperly entered executive session to discuss litigation strategy, including settlement, at its Dec 8 and Dec 15, 2014 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Discussion of settlement is clearly part of litigation strategy, and appropriate for executive session under Purpose 3.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
